observations: A stack of wooden pallets in an outdoor setting.
One pallet is propped upright to show the top deck and stringer construction.
The pallets appear to be 4-way entry block pallets.
The wood is light-colored and appears relatively dry in this shot.
A watermark 'EVOLVE INTERNATIONAL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Reliability depends on load-bearing capacity and wood integrity which cannot be tested remotely.
Wooden pallets are standard industrial items used for shipping, storage, and DIY furniture.

risks.risk: Structural damage such as split boards or loose nails.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the joints and individual deck boards.
Close-up photo of the wood surface showing no bore holes or frass.

risks.risk: Chemical contamination (Methyl Bromide treatment vs Heat Treated).
risks.proof: Photo of the IPPC stamp on the side blocks (HT or MB mark).
risks.if_unproven: as chemically treated (unsafe for indoor/furniture use)

risks.risk: Rot or moisture damage to the bottom pallets in the stack.
risks.proof: Photo of the pallets at the base of the stack.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the IPPC stamp on the side of the pallets to check treatment type.
Photos of the bottom-most pallets in the stack to check for ground rot.
Clear shot of the deck boards to check for cracks or heavy staining.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified as standard wooden pallets. They can be priced based on their visible condition as used utility pallets.
